INSERT INTO intervention_outcome (intervention_id, converted, order_id, revenue_amount, retained, window_days, measured_at) SELECT intervention_id, TRUE, order_id, total_price, TRUE, 7, NOW() FROM ( -- ②단계: 한 대응이 여러 주문의 직전 대응일 수 있으므로 그중 첫 주문만 SELECT DISTINCT ON (intervention_id) intervention_id, order_id, total_price FROM ( -- ①단계: 주문 1건은 그 주문 직전에 나간 대응 하나에만 귀속 SELECT DISTINCT ON (o.order_id) r.intervention_id, o.order_id, o.total_price, o.ordered_at FROM retention_intervention r JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = r.user_id AND o.payment_status = 'PAID' AND o.ordered_at > r.created_at AND o.ordered_at <= r.created_at + INTERVAL '7 days' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM intervention_outcome io WHERE io.intervention_id = r.intervention_id )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM intervention_outcome io2 WHERE io2.order_id = o.order_id ) ORDER BY o.order_id, r.created_at DESC, r.intervention_id DESC ) per_order ORDER BY intervention_id, ordered_at ) per_intervention ON CONFLICT (intervention_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO intervention_outcome (intervention_id, converted, order_id, revenue_amount, retained, window_days, measured_at) SELECT r.intervention_id, FALSE, NULL, 0, -- retained : 사지는 않았어도 돌아오긴 했는가(재방문). -- converted 와 같은 값이면 별도 지표일 이유가 없다. EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.user_id = r.user_id AND u.last_login_at > r.created_at), 7, NOW() FROM retention_intervention r WHERE r.created_at + INTERVAL '7 days' <= NOW() AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM intervention_outcome io WHERE io.intervention_id = r.intervention_id ) ON CONFLICT (intervention_id) DO NOTHING
